goals: Verify that strangeGame.enterGame does not trigger player imprisonment when the hour is 10.
Verify the specific success message returned by strangeGame.enterGame when a player is processed at hour 22 and not imprisoned.
Verify that strangeGame.enterGame correctly logs player IDs in the prison's log when multiple players enter the game at hour 22.
Verify that strangeGame can successfully retrieve a player's score from the GAMEDb dependency.
Verify the return message of strangeGame.donate when using a paypalService.
